title: Malicious code in character-ai-sdk (npm)
description: The character-ai-sdk npm package version 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 contains heavily obfuscated code that executes upon module import. It includes large obfuscated blobs referencing process control and host enumeration APIs, alongside native addons designed to detect virtual machines and sandbox environments. These behaviors are inconsistent with the package's stated purpose as a persona/memory SDK and indicate malicious intent to evade analysis and potentially execute harmful actions on the host system.
